# obot_mcp_tunnel (Resource)

Manages an MCP tunnel definition. Requires an Obot Admin or Owner. The tunnel can be created before an agent connects. The full token is captured only on creation or explicit rotation, is sensitive, and is stored in Terraform state. Import adopts the definition without changing credentials and leaves `token` null. Match existing metadata and keep `token_rotation_version` at 0 for adoption. See the [tunnel guide](../guides/mcp-tunnels.md) for import, secret-manager publication, rotation, and recovery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "obot_mcp_tunnel" "customer" {
  display_name = "Customer private network"
  description  = "Private MCP endpoints reached through the customer's agent"
  allowed_urls = ["https://mcp.internal.example/mcp"]

  # Increase this value to explicitly rotate and revoke the previous token.
  token_rotation_version = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_urls` (Set of String) Permitted target URLs or hostnames. A rule may have one wildcard at its beginning or end. An empty set denies all destinations. Obot rejects changes that would invalidate existing catalog-entry references.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable tunnel name. Updating it preserves the tunnel ID and token.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the private network or purpose. Defaults to an empty string.
- `token_rotation_version` (Number) Terraform-local rotation trigger. Defaults to 0 and is initialized to 0 on import. Increase it to explicitly rotate the secret without replacing the tunnel. Decreases are rejected. Rotation immediately revokes the old token and disconnects its clients.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The generated Obot tunnel ID, used by remote MCP catalog entries and import.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Complete tunnel bearer token, available after creation or explicit rotation. Null after import or an external rotation. Never populated from a preview. Protect Terraform state; sensitive values are still stored there.
- `token_preview` (String) Non-secret shortened preview of the current token. It cannot authenticate an agent.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_mcp_tunnel.customer
  identity = {
    id = "mt1example"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The generated Obot tunnel ID.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_mcp_tunnel.customer
  id = "mt1example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import obot_mcp_tunnel.customer mt1example
```
